item.title: The 3 Great Canon Lenses For Low Light Photographers
item.description: Quite recently, we spoke about the cameras that are perfect if you want to make images in the dark. While a camera is of utmost importance, we can't ignore that a lens adds to the charm of low-light photography. If you're still considering which lens to purchase, here are three great options that will deliver the best results in a jiffy.

item.title: Photographers: It’s Time to Give Your Mind a Rest
item.description: Dear photographers: it's time to put the camera down for a bit. You don't need to live behind your lens all the time and you need to realize that too much time with a camera can feel like a job that you don't want. So you need to give it a break. But this goes far beyond the camera. It's time for a visual detox. Visual media is copying one another way too much. And it's time for originality to shine.

item.title: An Intro to Screenless Digital Cameras
item.description: There have been a bunch of new cameras that have come out in the past few years. But the most fascinating ones for photographers are the new screenless digital cameras available now. These are an ode to a world long gone now, before social media, algorithms telling us what's a good photo vs what isn't, and global pandemics. item.title: I was Born Rich. Of Course, I’m a Leica Photographer
item.description: If there were ever a single camera company that has positioned itself at the center of the “greatest of all time” conversation, it is Leica. Born in Wetzlar, Germany, the original Leica changed photography and what was possible in it forever. And their fans will never let you forget this – assuming you can afford to vacation with them. There are many, many fans of the Red Dot camera – they are, after all, the Rolex of the camera world – but this article is certainly not for them.

item.title: The 3 Best Full-Frame Nikon Cameras That Dominate in High-ISO Shooting
item.description: Some Nikon cameras have models that perform better than others in low light. In the DSLR series, the DF, D850, and D750 were additions that offer good performance at night. But with the Z mount now a main component of the company, we have decided to reveal the models that shine bright when it comes to high ISO performance. If you like watching a lot at night, these offerings can be helpful.

item.title: The Designer Who Saw the Future of Cameras Before Anyone Else
item.description: Every era in photography has seen its share of standard camera designs. For instance, film cameras were rangefinder-style, offering a more or less the same set of built-in buttons.
